rules.rationale: The outermost svg element defines the frame `svg:<root-id>` in user units: its viewBox, else 0,0,width,height. A nested svg is folded into the cumulative transform (viewBox + preserveAspectRatio), so one frame covers the drawing. Confidence is derived when there is no viewBox.
The viewport rectangle of an svg element, in the frame (the viewBox rectangle for the root).

x,y,width,height read from the file; the cumulative transform is applied. Axis-aligned => kind box; rotated or skewed => exact polygon of the four transformed corners. rx/ry stay attributes (corner rounding is paint, not extent). Zero or missing size => geometry absent with the reason.
cx,cy,r read from the file => kind ellipse (+ enclosing bbox). Under a rotation or skew the ellipse is approximated by a polygon and the confidence drops to derived.
cx,cy,rx,ry read from the file => kind ellipse (+ bbox); polygon approximation (derived) under a rotation or skew.
x1,y1,x2,y2 (default 0) => kind segment in the frame, exact. Stroke width is paint and is not added to the extent.
points attribute => kind polyline, every point transformed; the bbox uses all points, at most 2000 points are listed.
points attribute => kind polygon (closed), every point transformed; the bbox uses all points.

rules.source: SVG 1.1 (Second Edition) 8 (path data); SVG 1.1 F.6 (arc conversion)
rules.rationale: Path data M m L l H h V v C c S s Q q T t A a Z z parsed to subpaths. Straight-line paths are exact (certain). Curves and arcs are flattened by sampling: the bbox is DERIVED and says so; a syntax error keeps the valid prefix and says so.
The x,y,width,height box of an embedded raster image, in the frame. The pixels are the image modality's business.
The x,y,width,height box of the foreignObject, in the frame.
Text gives an anchor POINT (x,y transformed). Glyph extents need font metrics and are not computed: bbox is absent and says so. A tspan with no x/y continues the text position: geometry absent.
A container's box is the union of its descendants' boxes (derived): stroke width, markers and text extents are not included.
A use element instantiates another element; the instantiated geometry is NOT computed here (honest absence). The Includes edge links to the referenced element.
A same-document use references the element with that id.
Records the reference text.
A use pointing at another document is left as a reference: it is never fetched or resolved.
Definition containers are not rendered; their subtree is hidden from effective visibility and their geometry is definition-space (absent in the frame).
display=none (presentation attribute) removes the element and its subtree from rendering.
visibility=hidden hides only the element itself.
Own presentation attribute `fill` recorded as an attribute of the node. Paint is not geometry; inheritance is not modelled.
Own presentation attribute `stroke` recorded as an attribute of the node. Paint is not geometry; inheritance is not modelled.
Own presentation attribute `stroke-width` recorded as an attribute of the node. Paint is not geometry; inheritance is not modelled.
Own presentation attribute `opacity` recorded as an attribute of the node. Paint is not geometry; inheritance is not modelled.
Own presentation attribute `fill-opacity` recorded as an attribute of the node. Paint is not geometry; inheritance is not modelled.
Own presentation attribute `stroke-opacity` recorded as an attribute of the node. Paint is not geometry; inheritance is not modelled.
Paint declarations from the inline style attribute (fill, stroke, stroke-width, fill-opacity, stroke-opacity). display / visibility / opacity come from the shared css cascade.
Text anchoring (start | middle | end) recorded; extents are not computed.
Font size recorded as given (units not resolved).
An svg root without an explicit role maps to graphics-document.
Accessible name from a direct <title> child when aria-label / aria-labelledby gave none; <desc> becomes the description.

props.reason: const:HTML inside foreignObject is analyzed by the html rules; its box is the foreignObject box

rules.rationale: foreignObject hosts non-SVG content. The HTML elements stay normal nodes in this graph (html rules apply: links, forms, scripts, safety); a ForeignContent node marks the boundary.

Filters, masks, clip paths, markers, patterns and CSS transforms in style attributes change what is drawn but are NOT modelled in the geometry. The affected nodes carry an `svg_unmodelled` list; nothing is guessed.
